full_prompt_en: A panoramic landscape photograph stretches along a still lake where autumn trees and luminous clouds meet their near-perfect reflection. The waterline runs horizontally through the middle of the scene, dividing the visible land and sky above from their darker mirror below. On the left, a low wooded bank recedes toward the center, its smaller golden trees washed by a pale patch of light. Near the middle, one leafless dark tree stands against a cool blue-gray opening. Slightly to its right, a much broader tree carries dense copper and rust-colored foliage, its trunk and spreading crown making the strongest landward silhouette. A thinner line of trees continues toward the far right, where a bright break in the cloud cover opens into a pale glowing horizon. Below, the lake repeats the dark branches, copper canopy, golden bank, and streaked clouds with remarkably little ripple. The reflection deepens the near-black values under the shoreline and doubles the broad warm mass near the center-right. The upper sky is filled with long, irregular cloud streaks in cream, slate, and gray-blue, their brightest part concentrated toward the right edge. No people, buildings, or readable text interrupt the scene. The photographic surface is crisp enough to distinguish branching patterns, yet the distant banks soften gently. Light appears low beyond the right horizon, warming the foliage and cloud edges while leaving trunks and bank in strong silhouette. The overall composition is expansive and symmetrical around its horizontal waterline, with cool dark framing balanced by a broad amber glow and the unusually calm mirrored surface.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅宽景风景照片沿平静湖面展开，秋树与明亮云层和几乎完整的倒影相接。水线横穿场景中央，将上方可见的陆地与天空和下方更深暗的镜像分开。左侧低矮林岸向中央退去，较小的金色树群受一片淡光洗亮。中央附近，一棵无叶深色树立在冷蓝灰色开口前。其右一棵更宽大的树带浓密铜色和铁锈色树冠，树干与铺开的枝叶形成陆地一侧最强剪影。更细的树线向右延伸，云层的明亮裂口在那里打开成浅亮地平线。下方湖面以几乎没有波纹的方式重复深色树枝、铜色树冠、金色岸边与条带状云。倒影加深岸线下方近黑明度，也将中右部宽阔暖色树团翻倍。上方天空布满奶油白、石板灰与灰蓝色的长条不规则云，最亮部分集中在右缘。没有人物、建筑或可读文字打断场景。摄影表面清楚到可辨枝条图案，远岸仍轻轻柔化。光线似乎从右侧低地平线之外照来，温暖树叶与云边，让树干和岸边保持强剪影。整体构图围绕横向水线宽广且近于对称，以冷暗框架平衡大片琥珀亮光和异常宁静的镜面。
style_prompt_en: A panoramic photographic composition extends the scene laterally, organized by a strong horizontal axis and a near-symmetrical reflection. Dark silhouettes and cool slate-blue areas frame a broad warm zone of amber and copper. Fine branching textures and cloud streaks give the upper half detail; the lower half repeats them with slightly softer, darker clarity, doubling the visual rhythm. A low directional light catches selected edges and distant highlights, while near trunks and banks remain deep shadow shapes. The eye travels across changes in scale rather than toward a single centered object. Water-like stillness and long uninterrupted bands keep the composition calm even when the sky has dramatic texture. The overall effect is expansive, balanced, and quietly luminous, with horizontal breadth and mirroring carrying the design.
style_prompt_zh: 宽景摄影构图横向延展，以强烈水平轴和近对称倒影组织场景。深色剪影与冷石板蓝区域框住大片琥珀与铜色暖区。细枝肌理和云纹给上半部细节，下半部以稍柔、稍暗的清晰度重复它们，使视觉节奏加倍。低角度定向光照亮选定边缘和远处亮部，近处树干与岸边仍为深暗形状。目光沿尺度变化横移，而非只趋向一个居中物体。水面般的静止与长长不断的色带使构图即使天空富戏剧肌理仍保持平静。整体宽广、均衡而含蓄发亮，由横向广度与镜像关系承担设计。
theme_en: Autumn trees and luminous clouds reflected in a still lake
theme_zh: 秋树与明亮云层映在平静湖面上
name: Panoramic composition
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
